pages.title: Categorize bank transactions
pages.content:
## Review the For Review tab

1. Open Transactions > Bank transactions.
2. For each row, accept the suggested category or pick one.
3. Match transfers to existing entries instead of adding duplicates.

pages.title: Run a Profit and Loss report
pages.content:
## Steps

1. Open Reports > Profit and Loss.
2. Set the period and accounting method (cash vs accrual).
3. Compare to the prior period before sharing.
